unit_tests: [test_MOD020_dev].[test a blank-mode line of a payment transaction does not drop its other lines]
[test_MOD020_dev].[test a payment transaction whose lines disagree takes its mode and amount from the lowest line_id]
[test_MOD020_dev].[test an event without a contact number fails the load logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]
[test_MOD020_dev].[test correcting a split payment result logs one insert one update and one delete]

steps.step: re-apply after rollback matches first apply

deviations: Choice the design leaves open: if the qualifying lines of one payment transaction (recid) disagree on mode, date or settled amount (they repeat in the source, so they should not), the line with the lowest line_id gives the values for the whole transaction, with postingtype and accountdisplayvalue breaking any tie. Lines with a blank mode are dropped before that line is picked, so a blank line never makes a transaction disappear. Covered by test_MOD020_dev.
notes:
MOD-020 changes one rule in Layercake.usp_load_silv_member_year_attributes (RULE-013, RULE-105). In the payment-line fallback, the qualifying lines are first cut down to one row per (segment invoice, recid). Only then are the settled amounts summed per mapped method. So a split payment adds its settleamountcur once, and the earliest-payment and lowest-recid tie-breaks work on whole transactions. Nothing else in the load changed. The down script restores the MOD-007 definition, and the round-trip passes. Starting point: 21 of 23 Tester tests passed and 2 failed (TC-020-001, TC-020-002), the split-payment cases. Now all 23 Tester tests and the 4 dev tests pass. The other readers (line-type mapping, eligible-invoice view, concession choice, segment and invoice anomaly loads) passed their retests at the new grain without any change. Dev tests cover: lines of one transaction that disagree (lowest line_id wins), a blank-mode line inside a transaction, the insert, update and delete counts with created_at kept, and the error path (an event with no contact_no fails with 515, is logged Failed and leaves the target unchanged).

Test-first: the first run had 21 of 23 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 23 of 23 and 4 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
